summary: Iteration 2: extended Logistics CRM tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed (root, idempotent seed=9 orders, dashboard period filter all/2026-02/2026-01/empty, clients with new bank+legal+cargo fields, carriers with new bank+regions, orders with new route_from_address/route_to_address/driver_name/driver_phone/vehicle_type/vehicle_plate persisted on POST and preserved on partial PUT, 404s, leads regression). Frontend (mobile 390x844): dashboard period chips render and switch — За всё время → 1 413 000 ₽, Янв 2026 → 350 000 ₽ (only 2 delivered), Фев 2026 chip present; Clients tab cards clickable → /client/[id] shows full bank requisites (Банк, БИК, р/с, к/с, ИНН, КПП, юр. адрес, что возят, направления) with edit-client-btn → save-client-btn flow; Carriers tab cards clickable → /carrier/[id] shows bank + transport (тип, гос.номер, регионы); Order create modal renders all new sections (ТОЧНЫЙ АДРЕС ЗАГРУЗКИ/ВЫГРУЗКИ, МАШИНА И ВОДИТЕЛЬ with ТИП ТС/ГОС. НОМЕР/ФИО ВОДИТЕЛЯ/ТЕЛЕФОН); Order detail shows seeded values for all new fields with editable inputs and save-btn. No red screens, no console errors (only the existing pointerEvents deprecation warning).

issues: Pre-existing console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents (cosmetic, RN web only)

action_items: Optional: replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence the lone RN web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auto-seed migration is idempotent and triggers on missing route_from_address — clean.
Order PUT uses OrderUpdate (partial, only non-None fields) — verified preserves untouched new fields.
Clients/Carriers PUT still full-overwrite via Payload (acceptable; detail screen sends the whole object on save).
Dashboard available_months derived from load_date prefixes — deduped, sorted desc, capped 12.
All new fields properly typed in Pydantic (Optional[str] / Optional[float]); _id excluded; CORS open; env vars used.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed; auto-seed on backend startup migrated DB to new schema (5 clients, 5 carriers, 9 orders [7 Feb 2026 + 2 Jan 2026], 7 leads). All TEST_* artifacts deleted by their tests.
